capabilities: Search books by title, author, or ISBN from the command palette or ribbon
Create a note from the selected result with metadata and cover image
Customize note templates, save location, and filename format in settings
Test the Kakao REST API key connection
Toggle cover image display in the search results list
extras: Detailed setup instructions are in Korean; the plugin must be built from TypeScript source to main.js and manually copied into the vault. It uses Obsidian's requestUrl() instead of fetch() to avoid CORS issues.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up book metadata online and generate book notes, so users must search elsewhere and enter details by hand.

relations.evidence: 기존에 쓰던 Templater 템플릿과 이름이 다를 때도 그대로 재사용할 수 있게

summary: Book search plugin that queries the Kakao Book Search API and creates a note with cover, authors, translators, publisher, ISBN, and description.
